cpmplus.rigpro.react.menu.desc: The selected parts move by themselves with something from the game: where the head looks, health, hunger, light, voice, punch, bow or one of your sliders.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.title: React to the game
cpmplus.rigpro.react.intro: The selected parts will move by themselves in game, following a value of the game. No button needed: it works all the time.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.preset.neck: Neck or spine follows the look
cpmplus.rigpro.react.preset.neck.help: Each part turns a share of where the head looks. Select the neck bones (from the body to the head). The real head should sit inside the last bone.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.preset.hang.help: When the head looks up or down the parts turn the other way and keep hanging down (no going through the chest). Each part's pivot should be where it attaches to the head.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.preset.droop.help: At low health the parts droop towards the ground, turning about their own pivot. At full health they stay as you modelled them.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.preset.glow.help: The parts only show when the place is dark (game light). Good for glowing eyes.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.preset.pose.help: You make the poses and choose what moves them: one pose at the minimum, another at the maximum, and the game blends them.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.notAlways: This only happens now and then: the rest of the time the parts stay at rest.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.amount.desc: 100 = the tip follows the whole head turn. Less = it follows only a bit.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.below.desc: 50 = above half health they stay normal, then droop until health runs out.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.light.desc: Minecraft light, from 0 (pitch dark) to 15 (sun). 7 = shows where monsters can already spawn.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.glowFlag.desc: Turns CPM's Glow effect on for the cubes of these parts, so they light up in the dark.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.captureHow: After creating, make the poses on the timeline: the start is the minimum, the end the maximum. Or pose first and open this window again to use the current pose.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.sim.desc: Moves the game value here in Blockbench so you see the result (only shows it, changes nothing).
cpmplus.rigpro.react.name: Animation name
cpmplus.rigpro.react.wrap: Move through an outer group when needed
cpmplus.rigpro.react.wrap.desc: Parts hidden by default or shown/hidden by another animation would always show (CPM bug #548). With this on, the motion goes on a new group around them.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.done: Reaction '%s' created. It works by itself in game.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.poseNext: Now make the poses: the end of the timeline is the maximum and the start is the minimum. To check, open 'React to the game…' again and use Simulate.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.undoCapture: Use the current pose (react to the game)
cpmplus.rigpro.react.edit.title: React to the game: adjust
cpmplus.rigpro.react.edit.intro: Adjusting '%s' (moved by: %s). Pose the parts on the timeline and click below to save the pose.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.err.noParts: Select the parts first (click them in the outliner).
cpmplus.rigpro.react.err.sliderName: The slider name can't contain # or :.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.err.sliderTaken: There is already a slider with that name: pick it in the list.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.err.headItself: Don't select Minecraft's head: it already turns by itself. Select the neck parts.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.err.neckNothing: Tick at least one: left and right, or up and down.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.err.droopNothing: No part has anywhere to droop (no cubes, or already pointing down).
cpmplus.rigpro.react.err.priority: No free priority left for this animation (255 values in use).
cpmplus.rigpro.react.err.notReaction: Select an animation that reacts to the game.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.warn.wrap: %s: hidden by default or shown/hidden by another animation. The motion goes on a new outer group (CPM bug #548).
cpmplus.rigpro.react.warn.visRiskOff: %s will always show in game (CPM bug #548): turn on 'Move through an outer group' in More options.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.warn.insideHead: %s is already inside the head and turns with it: it will turn twice as much.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.warn.notInHead: %s is not inside the head: it will counter-turn anyway.
cpmplus.rigpro.react.warn.headCopy: %s copies the head's motion with a multiplier: sometimes the head turns backwards (CPM bug #941). Use 'Neck or spine follows the look' instead.
cpmplus.rigpro.drv.newSlider: New slider (shows in the game menu)
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.menu.desc: The selected parts copy, live in game, the motion of a leg, arm, head, body, cape or elytra (skirt, shoulder pad, extra legs, wings, coat, gear).
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.title: Follow a body part
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.intro: The selected parts copy the motion of a body part LIVE in game, with no animation: they keep up with the walking speed. Each part goes into a new group that does the copying.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.preset.skirt.help: Follows the leg under it, softer (60%), turning at the hip.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.preset.pad.help: Follows the arm on its side by half, turning at the shoulder.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.preset.leg.help: Copies the leg on the same side. With several legs they alternate (one forward, the next back). A leg pointing sideways sweeps horizontally.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.preset.wing.help: Opens and closes like the elytra. Only moves with an elytra on; without one the wing stays in the pose you modelled.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.preset.coat: Coat or cloak on the cape
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.preset.coat.help: Swings forward and back like the cape, turning at the cape's point (shoulders).
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.preset.gear.help: Turns with a limb (back and forth with the step). Pick the axle in Direction.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.preset.custom.help: Pick the part, how much and the direction.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.src.head: Head
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.amount.desc: 100 = like the body part. 50 = half. Negative = the other way.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.sim.desc: Swings the body part here in Blockbench so you see the parts follow (only shows it).
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.limit: Limit: the copy can't delay the step. A spider foot sweeps but can't lift at the right moment. Full gaits will come later as animations.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.alternate.desc: Front to back: one the same, the next the other way.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.done: %s part(s) following. It works live in game.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.err.noParts: Select the parts first (not the whole body part).
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.err.rootPart: Pick parts inside the body parts, not the whole body part (CPM ignores copies there).
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.err.noAxis: Tick at least one turn to copy.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.err.noSource: Choose which body part to follow.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.err.headMult: Copying the head with anything but 100% sometimes turns the head backwards (CPM bug #941). Use 'React to the game… > Neck or spine follows the look'.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.warn.insideSource: %s is already inside that body part: it will move twice as much.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.warn.dirMulti: With more than one turn copied the direction stays 'Same'.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.warn.cape: Parts copying the cape may shake a bit when flying or running (CPM bug #721).
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.warn.elytra: Only moves with an elytra on. Without one it stays still.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.warn.head: Head copy: to follow the look with several parts use 'React to the game'.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.warn.addRoot: The model has no %s: it will be added (same as Add parts).
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.check.loop: %s and %s copy each other's motion (in a circle): CPM shows it wrong.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.check.order: %s copies the motion of %s, but that part comes later in the outliner: CPM applies the copies top to bottom and the copied motion doesn't arrive. Drag the copied part above it.
cpmplus.rigpro.follow.check.head: %s copies the head (%s) with a multiplier: sometimes the head turns backwards in game (CPM bug #941). Use 'React to the game' instead.
